pixel_region_interpretation: One outer polygon (loop 0) encloses two disjoint inner polygons (loops 1 and 2). The traced source candidate therefore supports a perforated section region, not three separate filled solids.
limitations: Nesting applies only to straight-segment traced polygons. Original raster overlay reviewed; hatch and inlet openings are consistent with this topology. Does not establish 3D duct continuity, wall thickness, metric accuracy or production readiness.
